title: Normalized tensor multiplication from etale quotient stalks
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use ordinary module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on a small representative of $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E,D\subseteq |T|$ be subsets and let
$$q:A_T\twoheadrightarrow F,\qquad s:A_T\twoheadrightarrow G,\qquad r:A_T\twoheadrightarrow H$$
be epimorphisms of $A_T$-module sheaves. Assume $F$ is flat, meaning tensoring with $F$ preserves short exact sequences [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every geometric point $\bar t$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], assume given $A$-linear identifications
$$F_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in E,\\0&t\notin E,\end{cases}\qquad
G_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in D,\\0&t\notin D,\end{cases}\qquad
H_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in E\cap D,\\0&t\notin E\cap D.\end{cases}$$
Under these identifications the stalk maps of $q,s,r$ are the identity of $A$ on their respective subsets and the zero map otherwise. Use sheaf tensor over $A_T$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and let
$$m:A_T\xrightarrow{\lambda^{-1}}A_T\otimes_{A_T}A_T\xrightarrow{q\otimes s}F\otimes_{A_T}G,$$
where $\lambda(a\otimes b)=ab$. Then $m$ is epic and there is a unique morphism $e:F\otimes_{A_T}G\to H$ with $e\circ m=r$. This morphism is an isomorphism and, for local sections $a,b$ of $A_T$, satisfies
$$e(q(a)\otimes s(b))=r(ab).$$
At $t\in E\cap D$ its stalk is $A\otimes_A A\to A$, $a\otimes b\mapsto ab$, with inverse $c\mapsto c\otimes1$; outside $E\cap D$ it is the unique map $0\to0$.
